env.name: vast_rtx3090
env.notes: Vast.ai RTX 3090 production environment. BF16 everywhere. Prefer FlashAttention-2 when the wheel is installed, otherwise SDPA is used and RECORDED — hardware.flash_attn_installed goes into every run report. Do not mix FA2 and SDPA runs inside one comparison; the attention implementation is part of the run's provenance. Results and model caches live under /workspace so a stopped instance keeps them.

agent_a.notes: A's model_utility drops 0.60 -> 0.46 at forget10. That degradation is exactly the confound the always_delegate control exists to rule out.

agent_b.notes: Same forget set as A. This is the pre-registered treatment arm.
